data: For fiscal 2025, the year ended January 26, 2025, NVIDIA reported revenue of $130.497 billion and net income of $72.880 billion, according to its Form 10-K filed February 26, 2025. Revenue rose from $60.922 billion in fiscal 2024 (ended January 28, 2024), an increase of about $69.6 billion or roughly 114%, so revenue more than doubled year over year. Net income grew faster, about 145% from $29.760 billion in fiscal 2024. Diluted earnings per share rose to $2.94 from $1.19. Gross margin was about 75.0% of revenue, compared with 72.7% a year earlier.
